## Other methods and analyses

- [**TL2BetaMiniLobby: reconstructing the Torchlight 2 beta lobby**](https://github.com/Crypto137/TL2BetaMiniLobby) - TL2BetaMiniLobby reconstructs the lobby service required by the May 2012 Torchlight 2 beta. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tl2-beta-mini-lobby-case/)</sub>
- [**tMock-Server: reconstructing Terraria server handshakes**](https://github.com/StardustVulpine/tMock-Server) - tMock-Server is an unfinished C++ reimplementation of the Terraria server's initial network flow. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tmock-server-case/)</sub>
- [**tModLoader Mobile: reconstructing selected mod behavior in Android Terraria**](https://github.com/dantefq/tmodloader-mobile) - tModLoader Mobile investigates selected PC Terraria mod behavior inside Android Terraria through an independently written managed compatibility layer and native bridges. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tmodloader-mobile-case/)</sub>
- [**Touhou reconstructions: an agent-driven method across three games**](https://rea.tools/blog/touhou-reconstruction/) - An essay published on REA’s site, with pinned evidence notes, describes one author’s agent-driven reconstructions of TH08, TH095 and TH04. <sub>Case study · Official REA · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rea-touhou-reconstruction-method-case/)</sub>
- [**tpp-server-emulator: a Metal Gear Solid V backend reconstruction**](https://github.com/alicealys/tpp-server-emulator) - tpp-server-emulator rebuilds the backend used by Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tpp-server-emulator-case/)</sub>

- [**Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection native Windows port**](https://github.com/bc160201983/Uncharted-The-Nathan-Drake-Collection-PC-port) - Runs the PS4 Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection’s own x86-64 executables natively on Windows: a runtime supplies the PS4 system libraries and a shadPS4-derived Vulkan renderer executes the GPU work. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/uncharted-collection-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Unicorn Overlord PC: rehosting the PS4 game on Linux and Windows**](https://github.com/hachi23/unicorn_overlord_pc) - Unicorn Overlord PC runs the PlayStation 4 Unicorn Overlord executable on Linux and Windows through a game-specific loader and host runtime. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/unicorn-overlord-pc-case/)</sub>
- [**uo-client: reconstructing the Ultima Online 2.0.7 client**](https://github.com/xrip/uo-client) - uo-client reconstructs the Ultima Online T2A 2.0.7 client in C++, including its packet protocol, MUL asset loading and isometric display. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/uo-client-case/)</sub>

- [**Virtua Cop 2: investigating PC game assets**](https://github.com/jevarg/re-virtua-cop-2) - The Virtua Cop 2 investigation examines the 1997 PC game's asset files with parsers, ImHex patterns and a browser explorer. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/re-virtua-cop-2-case/)</sub>

- [**Waygate: reconstructing Elden Ring matchmaking services**](https://github.com/vswarte/waygate-server) - Waygate reconstructs an Elden Ring matchmaking server around the game's multiplayer protocol. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/waygate-server-case/)</sub>
